dct_description_sm: At top of map; Supplement to the Illustrated London News, June 1, 1861.

At top of map; Supplement to the Illustrated London News, June 1, 1861. General map showing state and international boundaries, railroads, cities, rivers, and relief by hachures. Two colors are used to differentiate between Union and Confederate states. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:6,000,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 11.5 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
